description: Block-control constants shared by the core (include_str!) and the Desktop: container kinds that are controls (their direct children may have "auto" placement components; `composite` is the host of every composite extension control, its definition named by `def_ref`), the data controls among them (they show records of the tables they bind — projected, never stored as Blocks — hold no Blocks and have a numeric size) and the text views whose w / h may be "auto" (their size comes from the title).
